event_summary: A knife blade cuts through a small orange citrus piece on a glass cutting board, separating it into two pieces.
raw_event_description: A small orange citrus piece sits upright near the center of a textured transparent cutting board while a narrow metal knife blade is aligned through its middle. Over time the blade moves through the citrus piece, a central split becomes visible, and the right portion tips and moves to the right. By the end, two separate orange pieces are visible on opposite sides of the blade, with the left piece closer to the blade and the right piece farther to the right.

reasons: The citrus piece, knife blade, and cutting board are visible.
The blade is already aligned with and touching or entering the citrus piece.
The camera view is unobstructed aside from the blade partially covering the fruit center.
